answer: Perfect! All tests pass now. The issue was in the `bulk_discount` function at line 14 of `shopcart/pricing.py`. The condition was using `>` (greater than) instead of `>=` (greater than or equal to), which prevented the discount from applying when the quantity exactly equals the threshold. The docstring correctly states "when buying BULK_THRESHOLD units or more", so the fix aligns the logic with the specification.
